claims_corrected_for_terminal_1: 'LEACE dominates the repaired mechanism with no statistically detectable residence cost' is NARROWED. Recovery holds on 4/4 endpoints both weightings. The residence difference vs riv16-C1 is UNRESOLVED (+0.00357 [-0.00284,+0.00999] unweighted; +0.00396 [-0.00312,+0.01104] weighted), the interval CONTAINS SPLINCE's +0.00888 which the same analysis calls significant, and against LEACE's own source channel A0 the cost IS significant (+0.00978 [+0.00363,+0.01593] unweighted, +0.00779 [+0.00112,+0.01446] weighted; mean residence gain 0.0318 -> 0.0220).

'LEACE, SPLINCE and OptNet-C1 are statistically indistinguishable from J' is NARROWED to unresolved differences. No equivalence or non-inferiority test was run; all three point estimates lean towards J on A/SEX and two miss significance by under 0.0007.
'Coordinate dependence was acting as an implicit regulariser' is NARROWED to a hypothesis: METHOD.md section 0 lists five simultaneous changes and no ablation separates them.

DENOMINATOR CORRECTION: repair_vs_defective is 8 of 48 sensitive cells significantly worse (6 contrasts x 4 endpoints x 2 weightings), not 4. The prose counted contrast x endpoint rows. 0 of 48 better; 0 of 12 residence cells resolved either way.
'RAC1P class 3 has zero POPULATION support' is a FITTING-POOL count (1, 1, 0 by seed). The category is not absent from California. The structural finding survives with the right denominator.
J is NOT Pareto-dominant: spectral_riv16_L1 - J residence = -0.00797 [-0.01569,-0.00025], significantly MORE residence capability than J.

new_findings_contributed: The reporting scope of study 3's paired intervals was undocumented. Located by brute-force reproduction: a catch-up scope on the test split (expanded_catchup / kernel_expanded_catchup, budgets 120 and 360 both reproduce this cell). 4 of 24 combinations match; no *_independent scope does.

Every paired contrast between two arms is INVARIANT to that choice, because the shared H baseline cancels (verified: 0.00784-0.01589 = 0.00076-0.00881 = -0.00805). H-relative levels and ratios are NOT: the subtracted H baseline moves 0.00142 -> 0.00708 between scopes.

Measured counterexample to reading an attack maximum as a bound: J's absolute A/SEX recovery FALLS from 0.00271 to 0.00236 when given more attack candidates, because minimum-validation-loss selection can pick a candidate that generalises worse.
OptNet-L2 also beats riv16-C1 on all four sensitive endpoints under both weightings; the incoming report listed only OptNet-C1. SPLINCE beats it on 7 of 8, not 8 of 8.
